splitProtocol.method: Pre-model mixed-integer group assignment; balanced primary classes in fresh evaluation; L1 training membership balance.
splitProtocol.freshEvaluation: 120 new validation and 120 new test examples; twenty primary examples/category each; no group or headword shared with train or legacy evaluation.
splitProtocol.legacy: Original validation/test remain retired diagnostics; related new meanings stay with the old group, never in train or the fresh sets.

reviewType: AI semantic review; not human-expert ground truth
limitations: AI-authored/reviewed pilot; no independent human-expert annotation accuracy claim.
Class-balanced evaluation is not an estimate of real-app class prevalence.
Related examples share groups; 1000 rows do not imply 1000 independent meaning families.
